$comment: Z Clear — manual payment capture on an agency-issued invoice. Synthetic sample only. The amount is an agency service fee, not duty, VAT, tax or a ZRA assessment. No payment provider is called.

list.scope: Staff see tenant invoices; client_viewer sees only invoices on shipments where importer_user_id is their user id.

get.scope: Same importer scoping as list; unrelated importers receive 404.

payments.scope: Append-only payment rows for a visible invoice.

record.scope: Agency roles only; importers and drivers cannot record payments.

sampleRequest.note: Manual observation only; no money was moved by Z Clear.

sampleResponse.notes: Synthetic demo: agency clearance service fee only. Not a ZRA assessment; no duty or VAT included.

payments.note: Manual observation only; no money was moved by Z Clear.

guardrails: The seeded demo amount is a labelled agency service fee only; no customs duty, VAT, tax or assessment is invented.
Recording a payment is a manual observation of money paid off-platform. There is no Zamtel Money, bank or card integration and no money moves in this app.
Payments are append-only; balances and status are derived from recorded payments and are never edited directly.
Issued invoices are immutable. A wrong invoice is voided with a reason and reissued.
Every payment record emits a payment.recorded audit entry and a notification outbox event.
Invoice and quote reads are scoped to the importer assigned to the shipment; an unrelated importer receives an empty list or 404.
Drivers have no invoice, quote or payment permissions.

error.message: Payments can only be recorded against an issued invoice
